phase_name: Redeploy and verify the full gate set

objectives.description: Confirm deployed copies byte-identical to source store
Run validate-wiring.sh --all, confirm zero failures, VALIDATION PASSED
Move-aside/restore probe proves check still fails loudly
Run complete gate set (scoped per Batch Gate Deferral directive), confirm green

verification_notes: deploy-headless.sh redeployed the whole .claude/ tree; its own built-in fast-gate verification reported RESULT=landed_verify_red with 2 of 41 checks failed. Both failures are the pre-existing, out-of-scope findings named in this dispatch's briefing: (1) gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) exceeded its 30s wrapper timeout -- confirmed by running validate-state.sh --deep directly, which completed in 33.9s with STATE VALIDATION PASSED WITH WARNINGS (0 failed), proving this is the known wrapper-timeout flake, not a real regression; (2) lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh --verbose reported exactly the 2 named /ide findings in agent-system/extensions/memory/context/project/memory/{memory-setup.md,memory-troubleshooting.md}, unrelated to this task's scope. Neither finding was chased or touched, per the dispatch's explicit instruction. This task's own scope was verified directly and is fully green: deployed .claude/scripts/validate-wiring.sh and .claude/scripts/tests/test-validate-wiring.sh are byte-identical to the source store; bash .claude/scripts/validate-wiring.sh --all exits 0 with VALIDATION PASSED and zero Missing context file lines; the move-aside/restore probe (temporarily removing .claude/context/architecture/component-checklist.md) produced 'Missing context file [.claude]: architecture/component-checklist.md (expected at <full path>)' then returned to green after restore (git status confirms no residual diff on that file); bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --only test-validate-wiring.sh passes (10/10 assertions). Per this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, the complete full-tier gate set is not independently re-run a second time in this dispatch beyond deploy-headless.sh's own built-in fast-gate pass already executed above; the full set is deferred to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage, and its result is attributed back to this task via modified_files.
